title: Insurance (Valuation and Capital) Rules, L.N. 62 of 2024 — Capital adequacy thresholds
text: Subject to rule 5(2), an applicable insurer must maintain capital base at least equal to each of its prescribed capital amount, minimum capital amount and HK$20 million. Capital base follows Part 3; PCA follows Part 5.

title: Gazettal of subsidiary legislation under risk-based capital regime for insurance industry — 2026 rule changes and future commencement
text: The release announces gazettal of public-disclosure rules and 2026 valuation/capital amendments. Public-disclosure rules commence on gazettal; the RBC review amendments are scheduled for 31 December 2026. The release describes infrastructure, general-business, matching-adjustment and crypto/stablecoin changes.
